mechanics.claim: Umbra Blades periodically empowers Nocturne's next basic attack to slash in a circle, dealing increased physical damage to the target and nearby enemies and healing him per enemy hit.
mechanics.quote: Periodically, '''Nocturne''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} to slash in a circle, dealing {{as|120% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the target and nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The primary target of the empowered attack is dealt basic damage while secondary targets in the slash are dealt proc damage.
mechanics.quote: The primary target of the enhanced attack is dealt {{tip|basic damage}} while the secondary targets of the slash are dealt {{tip|proc damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Umbra Blades can critically strike against the primary target, changing its damage to 110% AD multiplied by Nocturne's total critical damage.
mechanics.quote: modifying the {{as|physical damage}} dealt to{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nocturne|crit_base}}|100|mod=1.1}} AD.|AD}}|{{as|110% AD}}{{times}}{{sti|{{as|'''total''' critical damage}}}}.}}

mechanics.claim: Against minions, Umbra Blades' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50%, and it applies on-hit effects to all targets at 100% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: Against {{tip|minions}}, ''Umbra Blades' '' damage to secondary targets and healing are reduced by 50% and it applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to all targets{{bug|2}} at 100% effectiveness.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks reduce Umbra Blades' cooldown by 1 second, increased to 3 seconds against enemy champions and monsters.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks reduce ''Umbra Blades' '' {{sti|cooldown}} by 1 second, increased to 3 against enemy {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: Parry effects only block the damage dealt to the primary target of Umbra Blades.
mechanics.quote: Parry effects will only block the damage dealt to the primary target.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack will not trigger against structures nor wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
